summary: ADP filed an 8-K reporting the entry into an underwriting agreement to issue and sell $1 billion of 5.000% senior notes due 2036. The notes were priced on May 4, 2026 and issued on May 7, 2026 under a shelf registration statement. Underwriters are BNP Paribas, BofA Securities, and J.P. Morgan. This is an ordinary debt issuance, not a special situation. The filing only updates a public debt takedown with no acquisition, restructuring, or event-driven catalyst.
